entities.name: Query protein TGT
observations: 374 aa protein; calculated molecular mass 41.50 kDa and pI 6.89.
Exact sequence match to reviewed Synechocystis sp. Q55983, a queuine tRNA-ribosyltransferase; identity and coverage 100%, E-value 2.63e-282.
Contains Pfam TGT domain PF01702 spanning residues 19–370.
Strong curated homologs Q8GAA6 and Q8YVT9 show 73.8–75.3% identity over approximately 98% coverage and the same catalytic annotation.

entities.name: Queuine tRNA-ribosyltransferase
observations: Catalyzes base exchange at tRNA anticodon wobble position 34 in tRNAs with GU(N) anticodons, including tRNA-Asp, -Asn, -His, and -Tyr.

Uses a double-displacement mechanism involving a covalent enzyme–RNA intermediate; annotated active-site roles include a proton acceptor near position 98 and a nucleophile near position 272 in the exact reference sequence.
Annotated as a homodimer; one monomer performs RNA recognition/catalysis and the partner binds PreQ1.
Binds one Zn2+ ion per subunit.

entities.name: PreQ1
observations: 7-aminomethyl-7-deazaguanine; the incoming queuine precursor in the TGT-catalyzed base-exchange reaction.

entities.name: TGT base exchange reaction
observations: 7-aminomethyl-7-carbaguanine + guanosine(34) in tRNA → 7-aminomethyl-7-carbaguanosine(34) in tRNA + guanine.
Mapped to Rhea RHEA:24104, with alternative directional records RHEA:10341 and RHEA:10342.
The immediate product is PreQ1-modified tRNA; subsequent reactions convert PreQ1 to queuine/queuosine.
